correctness.rationale: Exact Hintikka recursion maps atomic diagrams of ordered triples to Q(x,y), sets S(x) and global rank-three sentence invariant Σ. For b>=2 and h>=3, every extension z is x, y, adjacent to x/y, or neither; count |V|>2b+4 guarantees an outside witness, and common-neighbor cases split into sibling or grandparent/grandchild. Comparing ancestor/descendant positions and nearest branch points gives depth profiles with stable interior type from depth 3 through h−3. Hence branching beyond two does not affect Σ, and profiles collapse at height six; h=1,2 have b=2 vs >=3 local witness distinctions. Independent definition-level ordered-triple enumeration for (b,h)=(2,3,4)×h≤3 and b=2 h≤6 corroborated signature classes, including 127 vertices for T2,6. Infinite-height equivalence rests on proven finite locality/depth cases rather than extrapolating checks to h>60.
residual_risks: Classifies complete regular finite branching trees only, and rank exactly three, not arbitrary trees or counting FO.
